items.hebrew: וְה֤וּא רַח֨וּם ׀ יְכַפֵּ֥ר עָוֺן֮ וְֽלֹא־יַֽ֫שְׁחִ֥ית וְ֭הִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁ֣יב אַפּ֑וֹ וְלֹא־יָ֝עִ֗יר כׇּל־חֲמָתֽוֹ׃ יְיָ֥ הוֹשִׁ֑יעָה הַ֝מֶּ֗לֶךְ יַעֲנֵ֥נוּ בְיוֹם־קׇרְאֵֽנוּ׃ יְיָ֣ צְבָא֣וֹת עִמָּ֑נוּ מִשְׂגָּֽב־לָ֨נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃ יְיָ֥ צְבָא֑וֹת אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י אָ֝דָ֗ם בֹּטֵ֥חַ בָּֽךְ׃ אַ֭שְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י בֵיתֶ֑ךָ ע֝֗וֹד יְֽהַלְל֥וּךָ סֶּֽלָה׃ אַשְׁרֵ֣י הָ֭עָם שֶׁכָּ֣כָה לּ֑וֹ אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י הָ֝עָ֗ם שֱׁיְיָ֥ אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
items.translation: And He, being compassionate, pardons wrongdoing and does not destroy; time and again He turns back His anger, and does not rouse all His wrath. Adhonay, save us! May the King answer us on the day we call. Adhonay of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our stronghold, Selah. Adhonay of hosts, happy is the one who trusts in You. Happy are those who dwell in Your house; they shall praise You evermore, Selah. Happy is the people for whom this is so; happy is the people whose God is Adhonay.
items.translit: wĕhuʾ raḥum yĕkhapper 'awon wĕloʾ-yashĕḥith wĕhirba lĕhashiv ʾappo wĕloʾ-ya'ir kol-ḥămatho. Adhonay hoshi'a hammelekh ya'ănenu vĕyom-qorʾenu. Adhonay ṣĕvaʾoth 'immanu misgav-lanu ʾĕlohe ya'ăqov sela. Adhonay ṣĕvaʾoth ʾashĕre ʾadham boṭeaḥ bakh. ʾashre yoshĕve vethekha 'odh yĕhalĕlukha sela. ʾashre ha'am shekkakha lo ʾashĕre ha'am shĕAdhonay ʾĕlohaw.

items.hebrew: תְּהִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲרוֹמִמְךָ֣ אֱלוֹהַ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַאֲבָרְכָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃ בְּכׇל־י֥וֹם אֲבָרְכֶ֑ךָּ וַאֲהַלְלָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃ גָּ֘ד֤וֹל יְיָ֣ וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד וְ֝לִגְדֻלָּת֗וֹ אֵ֣ין חֵֽקֶר׃ דּ֣וֹר לְ֭דוֹר יְשַׁבַּ֣ח מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וּגְב֖וּרֹתֶ֣יךָ יַגִּֽידוּ׃ הֲ֭דַר כְּב֣וֹד הוֹדֶ֑ךָ וְדִבְרֵ֖י נִפְלְאֹתֶ֣יךָ אָשִֽׂיחָה׃ וֶעֱז֣וּז נֽוֹרְאֹתֶ֣יךָ יֹאמֵ֑רוּ וּגְדֻלָּתְךָ֥ אֲסַפְּרֶֽנָּה׃ זֵ֣כֶר רַב־טוּבְךָ֣ יַבִּ֑יעוּ וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃ חַנּ֣וּן וְרַח֣וּם יְיָ֑ אֶ֥רֶךְ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם וּגְדׇל־חָֽסֶד׃ טוֹב־יְיָ֥ לַכֹּ֑ל וְ֝רַחֲמָ֗יו עַל־כׇּל־מַעֲשָֽׂיו׃ יוֹד֣וּךָ יְיָ֭ כׇּל־מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וַ֝חֲסִידֶ֗יךָ יְבָרְכֽוּכָה׃ כְּב֣וֹד מַלְכוּתְךָ֣ יֹאמֵ֑רוּ וּגְבוּרָתְךָ֥ יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃ לְהוֹדִ֤יעַ ׀ לִבְנֵ֣י הָ֭אָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָ֑יו וּ֝כְב֗וֹד הֲדַ֣ר מַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃ מַֽלְכוּתְךָ֗ מַלְכ֥וּת כׇּל־עֹלָמִ֑ים וּ֝מֶֽמְשַׁלְתְּךָ֗ בְּכׇל־דּ֥וֹר וָדֹֽר׃ סוֹמֵ֣ךְ יְיָ֭ לְכׇל־הַנֹּפְלִ֑ים וְ֝זוֹקֵ֗ף לְכׇל־הַכְּפוּפִֽים׃ עֵֽינֵי־כֹ֭ל אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְשַׂבֵּ֑רוּ וְאַתָּ֤ה נֽוֹתֵן־לָהֶ֖ם אֶת־אׇכְלָ֣ם בְּעִתּֽוֹ׃ פּוֹתֵ֥חַ אֶת־יָדֶ֑ךָ וּמַשְׂבִּ֖יעַ לְכׇל־חַ֣י רָצֽוֹן׃ צַדִּ֣יק יְיָ֭ בְּכׇל־דְּרָכָ֑יו וְ֝חָסִ֗יד בְּכׇל־מַעֲשָֽׂיו׃ קָר֣וֹב יְיָ֭ לְכׇל־קֹרְאָ֑יו לְכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִקְרָאֻ֣הוּ בֶאֱמֶֽת׃ רְצוֹן־יְרֵאָ֥יו יַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְֽאֶת־שַׁוְעָתָ֥ם יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע וְיוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃ שׁוֹמֵ֣ר יְיָ֭ אֶת־כׇּל־אֹהֲבָ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת כׇּל־הָרְשָׁעִ֣ים יַשְׁמִֽיד׃ תְּהִלַּ֥ת יְיָ֗ יְֽדַבֶּ֫ר־פִּ֥י וִיבָרֵ֣ךְ כׇּל־בָּ֭שָׂר שֵׁ֥ם קׇדְשׁ֗וֹ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
items.translation: A praise of David. I will exalt You, my God the King, and bless Your name forever and ever. Every day I will bless You, and praise Your name forever and ever. Great is Adhonay and highly praised; His greatness is beyond all searching. One generation shall praise Your works to the next, and tell of Your mighty deeds. Of the glorious splendor of Your majesty, and of Your wondrous works, I will speak. They shall tell of the might of Your awesome deeds, and I will recount Your greatness. They shall pour forth the memory of Your great goodness, and sing with joy of Your righteousness. Gracious and compassionate is Adhonay, slow to anger and great in loving-kindness. Adhonay is good to all, and His compassion is upon all His works. All Your works shall thank You, Adhonay, and Your devout ones shall bless You. They shall tell of the glory of Your kingship, and speak of Your might; to make known to the children of man His mighty deeds, and the glorious splendor of His kingship. Your kingship is a kingship for all ages, and Your dominion endures through every generation. Adhonay supports all who fall, and raises up all who are bowed down. The eyes of all look to You in hope, and You give them their food in its season. You open Your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing. Adhonay is righteous in all His ways, and kind in all His works. Adhonay is near to all who call upon Him, to all who call upon Him in truth. He fulfills the desire of those who fear Him; He hears their cry and saves them. Adhonay guards all who love Him, but all the wicked He will destroy. My mouth shall speak the praise of Adhonay, and all flesh shall bless His holy name forever and ever.
items.translit: tĕhilla lĕdhawīdh ʾăromimkha ʾĕlohay hammelekh waʾăvarĕkha shimkha lĕ'olam wa'edh. bĕkhol-yom ʾăvarĕkhekka waʾăhalĕla shimkha lĕ'olam wa'edh. gadhol Adhonay umĕhullal mĕʾodh wĕlighdhullatho ʾen ḥeqer. dor lĕdhor yĕshabbaḥ ma'ăsekha ughĕvurothekha yaggidhu. hădhar kĕvodh hodhekha wĕdhivre niflĕʾothekha ʾasiḥa. we'ĕzuz norĕʾothekha yoʾmeru ughĕdhullathĕkha ʾăsappĕrenna. zekher rav-ṭwvĕkha yabbi'u wĕṣidhqathĕkha yĕrannenu. ḥannun wĕraḥum Adhonay ʾerekh ʾappayim ughĕdhol-ḥasedh. ṭov-Adhonay lakkol wĕraḥămaw 'al-khol-ma'ăsaw. yodhukha Adhonay kol-ma'ăsekha waḥăsidhekha yĕvarĕkhukha. kĕvodh malkhuthĕkha yoʾmeru ughĕvurathĕkha yĕdhabberu. lĕhodhia' livne haʾadham gĕvurothaw ukhĕvodh hădhar malkhutho. malĕkhuthĕkha malkhuth kol-'olamim umemĕshaltĕkha bĕkhol-dhor wadhor. somekh Adhonay lĕkhol-hannofĕlim wĕzoqef lĕkhol-hakkĕfufim. 'ene-khol ʾelekha yĕsabberu wĕʾatta nothen-lahem ʾeth-ʾokhlam bĕ'itto. potheaḥ ʾeth-yadhekha umasbia' lĕkhol-ḥay raṣon. ṣaddiq Adhonay bĕkhol-dhĕrakhaw wĕḥasidh bĕkhol-ma'ăsaw. qarov Adhonay lĕkhol-qorĕʾaw lĕkhol ʾăsher yiqraʾūhu veʾĕmeth. rĕṣon-yĕreʾaw ya'ăseh wĕʾeth-shaw'atham yishma' wĕyoshi'em. shomer Adhonay ʾeth-khol-ʾohăvaw wĕʾeth kol-harĕsha'im yashmidh. tĕhillath Adhonay yĕdhabber-fi wivarekh kol-vasar shem qodhsho lĕ'olam wa'edh.

items.hebrew: אומרים הביננו במקום שלש עשרה הברכות האמצעיות
items.translation: Hăvinenu is said in place of the thirteen middle bĕrakhoth.

items.hebrew: הֲבִינֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לָדַעַת דְּרָכֶיךָ, וּמוֹל אֶת לְבָבֵנוּ לְיִרְאָתֶךָ. תִּסְלַח לָנוּ לִהְיוֹת גְּאוּלִים. וְרַחֲקֵנוּ מִמַּכְאוֹב, וְדַשְּׁנֵנוּ בִּנְאוֹת אַרְצֶךָ, [בימות הגשמים: וְתֵן טַל וּמָטָר,] וּנְפוּצִים מֵאַרְבַּע תְּקַבֵּץ, וְהַתּוֹעִים בְּדַעְתְּךָ יִשָּׁפֵטוּ, וְעַל הָרְשָׁעִים תָּנִיף יָדֶךָ, וְיִשְׂמְחוּ צַדִּיקִים בְּבִנְיַן עִירָךְ וּבְתִקּוּן הֵיכָלָךְ, וּבִצְמִיחַת קֶרֶן לְדָוִד עַבְדָּךְ, וּבַעֲרִיכַת נֵר לְבֶן יִשַׁי מְשִׁיחָךְ. טֶרֶם נִקְרָא וְאַתָּה תַעֲנֶה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, שׁוֹמֵעַ תְּפִלָּה.
items.translation: Give us understanding, Adhonay our God, to know Your ways, and circumcise our hearts to fear You. Forgive us, that we may be redeemed. Keep us far from pain, and make us flourish in the pastures of Your land; [in the rainy season: and give dew and rain;] gather the scattered from the four corners; let those who stray be judged by Your will; and raise Your hand against the wicked. Let the righteous rejoice in the building of Your city and the restoring of Your Temple, in the springing forth of a horn for David, Your servant, and in the setting of a lamp for the son of Jesse, Your anointed. Before we call, You will answer. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who hears prayer.
items.translit: hăvinenu Adhonay ʾĕlohenu ladha'ath dĕrakhekha, umol ʾeth lĕvavenu lĕyirʾathekha. tislaḥ lanu lihyoth gĕʾulim. wĕraḥăqenu mimmakhʾov, wĕdhashshĕnenu binʾoth ʾarṣekha, [vymwth hghshmym: wĕthen ṭal umaṭar,] unĕfuṣim meʾarba' tĕqabbeṣ, wĕhatto'im bĕdha'tĕkha yishshafeṭu, wĕ'al harĕsha'im tanif yadhekha, wĕyismĕḥu ṣaddiqim bĕvinyan 'irakh uvĕthiqqun hekhalakh, uviṣmiḥath qeren lĕdhawīdh 'avdakh, uva'ărikhath ner lĕven yishay mĕshiḥakh. ṭerem niqraʾ wĕʾatta tha'ăneh. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, shomea' tĕfilla.

items.hebrew: לְפָנֶיךָ אָנוּ כּוֹרְעִים וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים וּמִתְפַּלְּלִים וּמִתְחַנְּנִים. אָנָּא אֲדוֹן הָעוֹלָמִים, אֱלֹהֵי הָאֱלֹהִים וַאֲדוֹנֵי הָאֲדוֹנִים, שְׁמַע קוֹלֵנוּ וְקַבֵּל תְּפִלָּתֵנוּ וּרְצֵה אֶת תְּחִנָּתֵנוּ, וּפְנֵה בְּרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים אֵלֵינוּ, וְאַל תְּשִׁיבֵנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ רֵיקָם מִלְּפָנֶיךָ. כִּ֣י ׀ לֹ֣א עַל־צִדְקֹתֵ֗ינוּ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ מַפִּילִ֤ים תַּחֲנוּנֵ֙ינוּ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ כִּ֖י עַל־רַחֲמֶ֥יךָ הָרַבִּֽים׃ אֲדֹנָ֤י ׀ שְׁמָ֙עָה֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י ׀ סְלָ֔חָה אֲדֹנָ֛י הַֽקְשִׁ֥יבָה וַעֲשֵׂ֖ה אַל־תְּאַחַ֑ר לְמַֽעַנְךָ֣ אֱלֹהַ֔י כִּֽי־שִׁמְךָ֣ נִקְרָ֔א עַל־עִירְךָ֖ וְעַל־עַמֶּֽךָ׃ שׁ֚וּב מֵחֲר֣וֹן אַפֶּ֔ךָ וְהִנָּחֵ֥ם עַל־הָרָעָ֖ה לְעַמֶּֽךָ׃ שׁ֚וּב לְמַ֣עַן עֲבָדֶ֔יךָ שִׁבְטֵ֖י נַחֲלָתֶֽךָ׃ זְכֹר֙ לַעֲבָדֶ֔יךָ לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֑ב אַל־תֵּ֗פֶן אֶל־קְשִׁי֙ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה וְאֶל־רִשְׁע֖וֹ וְאֶל־חַטָּאתֽוֹ׃
items.translation: Before You we kneel and bow down, we pray and plead. We beseech You, Master of the worlds, God of gods and Lord of lords: hear our voice, receive our prayer, and accept our plea with favor; turn to us in Your great compassion, and do not turn us away empty from before You, our King. For not on account of our own righteousness do we lay our pleas before You, but on account of Your great compassion. My Lord, hear! My Lord, forgive! My Lord, give heed and act; do not delay — for Your own sake, my God, for Your name is called upon Your city and upon Your people. Turn from Your burning anger, and relent from the harm intended for Your people. Return, for the sake of Your servants, the tribes of Your inheritance. Remember Your servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob; do not look to the stubbornness of this people, nor to its wickedness, nor to its failings.
items.translit: lĕfanekha ʾanu korĕ'im umishtaḥăwim umithpallĕlim umithḥannĕnim. ʾannaʾ ʾădhon ha'olamim, ʾĕlohe haʾĕlohim waʾădhone haʾădhonim, shĕma' qolenu wĕqabbel tĕfillathenu urĕṣeh ʾeth tĕḥinnathenu, ufĕneh bĕraḥămekha harabbim ʾelenu, wĕʾal tĕshivenu malkenu reqam millĕfanekha. ki loʾ 'al-ṣidhqothenu ʾănaḥnu mappilim taḥănunenu lĕfanekha ki 'al-raḥămekha harabbim. ʾădhonay shĕma'a ʾădhonay sĕlaḥa ʾădhonay haqĕshiva wa'ăseh ʾal-thĕʾaḥar lĕma'ankha ʾĕlohay ki-shimkha niqraʾ 'al-'irĕkha wĕ'al-'ammekha. shuv meḥăron ʾappekha wĕhinnaḥem 'al-hara'a lĕ'ammekha. shuv lĕma'an 'ăvadhekha shivṭe naḥălathekha. zĕkhor la'ăvadhekha lĕʾavraham lĕyiṣḥaq ulĕya'ăqov ʾal-thefen ʾel-qĕshi ha'am hazzeh wĕʾel-rish'o wĕʾel-ḥaṭṭaʾtho.

items.hebrew: רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן חָטָאנוּ לְפָנֶיךָ, רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ.
items.translation: Compassionate and gracious One, we have erred before You; have mercy on us and save us.
items.translit: raḥum wĕḥannun ḥaṭaʾnu lĕfanekha, raḥem 'alenu wĕhoshi'enu.

items.hebrew: לְדָוִ֡ד אֵלֶ֥יךָ יְיָ֝֗ נַפְשִׁ֥י אֶשָּֽׂא׃ אֱֽלֹהַ֗י בְּךָ֣ בָ֭טַחְתִּי אַל־אֵב֑וֹשָׁה אַל־יַעַלְצ֖וּ אוֹיְבַ֣י לִֽי׃ גַּ֣ם כׇּל־קֹ֭וֶיךָ לֹ֣א יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ יֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ הַבּוֹגְדִ֥ים רֵיקָֽם׃ דְּרָכֶ֣יךָ יְיָ֭ הוֹדִיעֵ֑נִי אֹ֖רְחוֹתֶ֣יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃ הַדְרִ֘יכֵ֤נִי בַאֲמִתֶּ֨ךָ ׀ וְֽלַמְּדֵ֗נִי כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֑י אוֹתְךָ֥ קִ֝וִּ֗יתִי כׇּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃ זְכֹר־רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ יְיָ֭ וַחֲסָדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י מֵעוֹלָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה׃ חַטֹּ֤אות נְעוּרַ֨י ׀ וּפְשָׁעַ֗י אַל־תִּ֫זְכֹּ֥ר כְּחַסְדְּךָ֥ זְכׇר־לִי־אַ֑תָּה לְמַ֖עַן טוּבְךָ֣ יְיָ׃ טוֹב־וְיָשָׁ֥ר יְיָ֑ עַל־כֵּ֤ן יוֹרֶ֖ה חַטָּאִ֣ים בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃ יַדְרֵ֣ךְ עֲ֭נָוִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וִילַמֵּ֖ד עֲנָוִ֣ים דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃ כׇּל־אׇרְח֣וֹת יְיָ֭ חֶ֣סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֑ת לְנֹצְרֵ֥י בְ֝רִית֗וֹ וְעֵדֹתָֽיו׃ לְמַֽעַן־שִׁמְךָ֥ יְיָ֑ וְֽסָלַחְתָּ֥ לַ֝עֲוֺנִ֗י כִּ֣י רַב־הֽוּא׃ מִי־זֶ֣ה הָ֭אִישׁ יְרֵ֣א יְיָ֑ י֝וֹרֶ֗נּוּ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יִבְחָֽר׃ נַ֭פְשׁוֹ בְּט֣וֹב תָּלִ֑ין וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ יִ֣ירַשׁ אָֽרֶץ׃ ס֣וֹד יְיָ֭ לִירֵאָ֑יו וּ֝בְרִית֗וֹ לְהוֹדִיעָֽם׃ עֵינַ֣י תָּ֭מִיד אֶל־יְיָ֑ כִּ֤י הֽוּא־יוֹצִ֖יא מֵרֶ֣שֶׁת רַגְלָֽי׃ פְּנֵֽה־אֵלַ֥י וְחׇנֵּ֑נִי כִּֽי־יָחִ֖יד וְעָנִ֣י אָֽנִי׃ צָר֣וֹת לְבָבִ֣י הִרְחִ֑יבוּ מִ֝מְּצוּקוֹתַ֗י הוֹצִיאֵֽנִי׃ רְאֵ֣ה עׇ֭נְיִי וַעֲמָלִ֑י וְ֝שָׂ֗א לְכׇל־חַטֹּאותָֽי׃ רְאֵֽה־אֹיְבַ֥י כִּי־רָ֑בּוּ וְשִׂנְאַ֖ת חָמָ֣ס שְׂנֵאֽוּנִי׃ שׇׁמְרָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי וְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי אַל־אֵ֝ב֗וֹשׁ כִּֽי־חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ׃ תֹּם־וָיֹ֥שֶׁר יִצְּר֑וּנִי כִּ֝֗י קִוִּיתִֽיךָ׃ פְּדֵ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִ֝כֹּ֗ל צָרוֹתָֽיו׃
items.translation: Of David. To You, Adhonay, I lift up my soul. My God, in You I have trusted; let me not be put to shame, let not my enemies exult over me. Indeed, none who hope in You shall be put to shame; those shall be shamed who betray without cause. Make Your ways known to me, Adhonay; teach me Your paths. Lead me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation; for You I have hoped all day long. Remember Your compassion, Adhonay, and Your kindnesses, for they are from of old. The failings of my youth and my acts of defiance, do not remember; in Your loving-kindness remember me, for the sake of Your goodness, Adhonay. Good and upright is Adhonay; therefore He shows the way to those who err. He leads the humble in what is just, and teaches the humble His way. All the paths of Adhonay are loving-kindness and truth, for those who keep His covenant and His testimonies. For the sake of Your name, Adhonay, pardon my wrongdoing, for it is great. Who is the one who fears Adhonay? He will show him the way that he should choose. His soul shall dwell in goodness, and his children shall inherit the land. The counsel of Adhonay is with those who fear Him, and His covenant, to make it known to them. My eyes are ever toward Adhonay, for He will free my feet from the net. Turn to me and be gracious to me, for I am alone and afflicted. The troubles of my heart have grown wide; bring me out of my distress. See my affliction and my toil, and forgive all my failings. See my enemies, how many they are, and with what violent hatred they hate me. Guard my soul and deliver me; let me not be put to shame, for I have taken refuge in You. May integrity and uprightness keep me, for I have hoped in You. Redeem Israel, O God, from all its troubles.
items.translit: lĕdhawīdh ʾelekha Adhonay nafshi ʾessaʾ. ʾĕlohay bĕkha vaṭaḥti ʾal-ʾevosha ʾal-ya'alṣu ʾoyĕvay li. gam kol-qowekha loʾ yevoshu yevoshu habboghĕdhim reqam. dĕrakhekha Adhonay hodhi'eni ʾorĕḥothekha lammĕdheni. hadhrikheni vaʾămittekha wĕlammĕdheni ki-ʾatta ʾĕlohe yish'i ʾothĕkha qiwwithi kol-hayyom. zĕkhor-raḥămekha Adhonay waḥăsadhekha ki me'olam hemma. ḥaṭṭoʾwth nĕ'uray ufĕsha'ay ʾal-thizkor kĕḥasdĕkha zĕkhor-li-ʾatta lĕma'an ṭuvĕkha Adhonay. ṭov-wĕyashar Adhonay 'al-khen yoreh ḥaṭṭaʾim baddarekh. yadhrekh 'ănawim bammishpaṭ wilammedh 'ănawim darko. kol-ʾorḥoth Adhonay ḥesedh weʾĕmeth lĕnoṣĕre vĕritho wĕ'edhothaw. lĕma'an-shimkha Adhonay wĕsalaḥta la'ăwoni ki rav-hwʾ. mi-zeh haʾish yĕreʾ Adhonay yorennu bĕdherekh yivḥar. nafsho bĕṭov talin wĕzar'o yirash ʾareṣ. sodh Adhonay lireʾaw uvĕritho lĕhodhi'am. 'enay tamidh ʾel-Adhonay ki huʾ-yoṣiʾ meresheth raghlay. pĕneh-ʾelay wĕḥonneni ki-yaḥidh wĕ'ani ʾani. ṣaroth lĕvavi hirḥivu mimmĕṣuqothay hoṣiʾeni. rĕʾeh 'onyi wa'ămali wĕsaʾ lĕkhol-ḥaṭṭoʾwthay. rĕʾeh-ʾoyĕvay ki-rabbu wĕsinʾath ḥamas sĕneʾuni. shomra nafshi wĕhaṣṣileni ʾal-ʾevosh ki-ḥasithi vakh. tom-wayosher yiṣṣĕruni ki qiwwithikha. pĕdheh ʾĕlohim ʾeth-yisraʾel mikkol ṣarothaw.

items.translation: And He will redeem Israel from all its wrongs.

items.hebrew: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ אָבִינוּ אַתָּה. אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ אֵין לָנוּ מֶלֶךְ אֶלָּא אַתָּה. אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ. אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ חָנֵּנוּ וַעֲנֵנוּ כִּי אֵין בָּנוּ מַעֲשִׂים, עֲשֵׂה עִמָּנוּ צְדָקָה וָחֶסֶד לְמַעַן שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ.
items.translation: Our Father, our King, You are our Father. Our Father, our King, we have no king but You. Our Father, our King, have mercy on us. Our Father, our King, be gracious to us and answer us, for we have no deeds to our name; deal with us in charity and loving-kindness, for the sake of Your great name, and save us.
items.translit: ʾavinu malkenu ʾavinu ʾatta. ʾavinu malkenu ʾen lanu melekh ʾellaʾ ʾatta. ʾavinu malkenu raḥem 'alenu. ʾavinu malkenu ḥannenu wa'ănenu ki ʾen banu ma'ăsim, 'ăseh 'immanu ṣĕdhaqa waḥesedh lĕma'an shimkha haggadhol wĕhoshi'enu.

items.hebrew: וַאֲנַ֗חְנוּ לֹ֤א נֵדַע֙ מַֽה־נַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה כִּ֥י עָלֶ֖יךָ עֵינֵֽינוּ׃ זְכֹר־רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ יְיָ֭ וַחֲסָדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י מֵעוֹלָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה׃ אַֽל־תִּזְכׇּר־לָנוּ֮ עֲוֺנֹ֢ת רִאשֹׁ֫נִ֥ים מַ֭הֵר יְקַדְּמ֣וּנוּ רַחֲמֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י דַלּ֣וֹנוּ מְאֹֽד׃ ק֭וּמָֽה עֶזְרָ֣תָה לָּ֑נוּ וּ֝פְדֵ֗נוּ לְמַ֣עַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ׃ יְהִי־חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְיָ֣ עָלֵ֑ינוּ כַּ֝אֲשֶׁ֗ר יִחַ֥לְנוּ לָֽךְ׃ אִם־עֲוֺנ֥וֹת תִּשְׁמׇר־יָ֑הּ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י מִ֣י יַעֲמֹֽד׃ כִּֽי־עִמְּךָ֥ הַסְּלִיחָ֑ה לְ֝מַ֗עַן תִּוָּרֵֽא׃ יְיָ֥ הוֹשִׁ֑יעָה הַ֝מֶּ֗לֶךְ יַעֲנֵ֥נוּ בְיוֹם־קׇרְאֵֽנוּ׃ כִּי־ה֭וּא יָדַ֣ע יִצְרֵ֑נוּ זָ֝כ֗וּר כִּי־עָפָ֥ר אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃ עׇזְרֵ֤נוּ ׀ אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׁעֵ֗נוּ עַֽל־דְּבַ֥ר כְּבֽוֹד־שְׁמֶ֑ךָ וְהַצִּילֵ֥נוּ וְכַפֵּ֥ר עַל־חַ֝טֹּאתֵ֗ינוּ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
items.translation: As for us, we do not know what to do, but our eyes are upon You. Remember Your compassion, Adhonay, and Your kindnesses, for they are from of old. Do not remember against us the wrongs of those before us; let Your compassion come swiftly to meet us, for we are brought very low. Arise, be our help, and redeem us for the sake of Your loving-kindness. May Your loving-kindness, Adhonay, be upon us, as we have hoped in You. If You should keep count of wrongs, O Yah — my Lord, who could stand? But with You there is forgiveness, that You may be held in awe. Adhonay, save us! May the King answer us on the day we call. For He knows how we are formed; He remembers that we are dust. Help us, God of our salvation, for the sake of the glory of Your name; deliver us and pardon our failings, for the sake of Your name.
items.translit: waʾănaḥnu loʾ nedha' mah-na'ăseh ki 'alekha 'enenu. zĕkhor-raḥămekha Adhonay waḥăsadhekha ki me'olam hemma. ʾal-thizkor-lanu 'ăwonoth riʾshonim maher yĕqaddĕmunu raḥămekha ki dhallonu mĕʾodh. quma 'ezratha lanu ufĕdhenu lĕma'an ḥasdekha. yĕhi-ḥasdĕkha Adhonay 'alenu kaʾăsher yiḥalnu lakh. ʾim-'ăwonoth tishmor-ya ʾădhonay mi ya'ămodh. ki-'immĕkha hassĕliḥa lĕma'an tiwwareʾ. Adhonay hoshi'a hammelekh ya'ănenu vĕyom-qorʾenu. ki-hwʾ yadha' yiṣrenu zakhur ki-'afar ʾănaḥĕnu. 'ozrenu ʾĕlohe yish'enu 'al-dhĕvar kĕvodh-shĕmekha wĕhaṣṣilenu wĕkhapper 'al-ḥaṭṭoʾthenu lĕma'an shĕmekha.
